verdict.rationale: Granola's own mobile app is documented for AI-enhanced notes during in-person meetings, and transcription on mobile is supported in 17 languages. Separately, Chat can query across all meetings, and community users report the mobile and Apple Watch capture works. However, no evidence explicitly states that mobile-captured notes sync into the same workspace where search and Chat operate, so the 'same searchable workspace' half is only implied. missing for 10: explicit documentation that mobile recordings sync into the shared desktop/team workspace and are searchable there, independent hands-on corroboration of in-person mobile transcription quality.

support.subject: As a founder, I can record and transcribe in-person conversations from a mobile app, and those notes land in the same searchable workspace

citations.quote: Granola for mobile lets you take AI-enhanced notes during in-person meetings (and, on iOS, phone calls).
Granola supports 31 languages on desktop (macOS and Windows) and 17 languages on mobile (iOS and Android).
You can use Chat from your home screen to query all of your meetings, on a single meeting, or in any other set of meetings such as a folder
search through your meeting notes, find specific topics discussed in past meetings
